Huovilainen derives the ladder stage from the transistor differential-pair tanh law, solves the resulting differential equation with explicit (forward) Euler, and obtains a cascade of four first-order IIR sections with embedded tanh non-linearities; only five tanh evaluations per sample are needed (table or polynomial approximation allowed).
